{{Quote|That little green girl, Iopiane Ratle, finished all her bounties. Heard she poisoned an Imperial Moff!|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="TOR:FC">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Family Cleansing|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
'''Iopiane Ratle''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'd wish you luck, but it wouldn't help. So, I'll just say goodbye.|Iopiane Ratle, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> she was one of the bounty hunters to attend a galactic competition known as the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] after poisoning an Imperial [[Moff]]. She was killed during the [[Grand Melee]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
